observations.body: In Antioch’s diverse leadership, worship and fasting frame the Holy Spirit’s command to set apart Barnabas and Saul; prayer, hands, and sending follow.
observations.label: The Spirit names and sends Barnabas and Saul

payload.posture: Read Acts 13:1–4 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states in Antioch’s diverse leadership, worship and fasting frame the Holy Spirit’s command to set apart Barnabas and Saul; prayer, hands, and sending follow. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
